description: Hurricane Michael Reconn-Large Volume Buildings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by David Roueche, Auburn University (auburn.edu). Reconnaissance data for a RAPID project on large volume building damage in Hurricane Michael. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: hurricane, steel buildings, reconnaissance. Published 2020-02-14. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
